en: A black‑and‑white interior view of a brick crypt or underground chapel. The vaulted ceiling and thick brick columns form rounded arches. In the background, up a few steps, stands a simple altar with candles. The space is sparsely decorated and lit by a single lamp on the ceiling, giving a solemn, contemplative atmosphere typical of early‑20th‑century ecclesiastical architecture.
